about: Contract between the Plotter language model and the game. The model reads (level, instruction) and returns a probability for each slot of that level plus 'unknown'. Slots describe what the player ASKED FOR, not what the AI does: the planner (js/sim/planner.js) turns slots into a plan and makes the AI's literal / typical-case mistakes. Numbers (minutes, tonnes) are extracted by regex in plotter.js, not by the model.

slots.best: generic 'best / good / nice / perfect / ideal' land with no stated reason
slots.flat: flat, level, easy to build on
slots.sunny: sunny, south-facing, warm, gets the sun
slots.dry: dry, high ground, does not flood, safe from the river, avoids winter flooding
slots.keep_meadow: keep / protect / don't build on the meadow, wildflowers, river meadow
slots.keep_wood: keep / protect the wood, forest, trees
slots.keep_wetland: keep / protect the wetland, marsh, pond, reeds
slots.big: lots of space, room to grow, big area

canonical.clear: Dry, sunny land. Keep the meadow wild.

slots.easy_access: easy / quick / convenient for everyone to get to school or around town, with no mode stated
slots.safe_walking: safe walking, footpaths, pavements, safe crossings, children can walk
slots.cycling: bikes, cycle lanes, cycle paths, cycling
slots.cars_at_edge: cars stay / park at the edge, parking outside the centre
slots.fast: fast, quick journeys, less traffic jams
slots.everyone: everyone including children, wheelchair users, people without cars (explicitly naming who)

canonical.vague: Make it easy for everyone to get to school
canonical.clear: Safe walking and cycling routes. Cars stay at the edge.

slots.many: lots of homes, as many as possible, room for many families
slots.low_carbon: low carbon, eco, green, small carbon footprint, less pollution
slots.warm: warm, cosy, insulated, low heating, comfortable in winter
slots.natural_materials: timber, wood, straw, straw bale, rammed earth, natural or local materials

canonical.clear: Warm, low-carbon homes from local timber and straw.

slots.max_food: as much food as possible, most food, maximum, huge harvest
slots.enough_food: enough food for everyone, feed the town (sufficiency, not maximum)
slots.keep_hedges: keep / don't cut the hedges, hedgerows
slots.bees: bees, pollinators, beehives, flowers for bees
slots.local: grown locally, on the island, no lorries, close to homes
slots.allotments: allotments, gardens, people grow their own

canonical.vague: Grow as much food as possible
canonical.clear: Enough food, and keep the hedges for the bees.

slots.clean_power: clean / green / renewable power, no fossil fuels
slots.enough_power: enough power, lights always on, reliable power
slots.winter: winter, cold days, still days with no wind, the worst case
slots.night: night, when the sun isn't shining, after dark
slots.storage: store energy, batteries, save sunshine for later
slots.save_water: rain gardens, save water, stop flooding with plants, wetland

canonical.clear: Enough power for a still winter night. Store the sunshine.

slots.middle: in the middle, centre, central (of the town or island)
slots.walk_time: within N minutes' walk, short walk, walking distance
slots.near_homes: close to / next to the homes, where people live
slots.nature_links: connect nature, green corridor, green bridge, hedgerow links
slots.market: market, shops, town square, meeting place
slots.safe_route: safe route to school, away from traffic

canonical.vague: Put the school in the middle
canonical.clear: School within a 10-minute walk of every home.

unknown: off-topic, nonsense, rude or unsafe input, or an instruction for a different level's topic; the game replies 'I don't know how to plan that yet.'
